name: hmi_rename_tag
description: Rename one Unified HMI tag in place with TIA's own rename (the tag is never deleted and recreated), including tags in grouped tag tables. Before renaming, a best-effort scan lists structured references (alarms, other tags, runtime settings, dynamizations, button parts, script trigger tags) and script text occurrences; after renaming, each structured reference is read back and reported with Updated=true or false. TIA cross-references are listed in CrossReferences but not read back. Structured references are never rewritten by this tool. script_references='replace' also rewrites script string literals that are exactly the old name ("Old" or 'Old'), only in scripts that have a syntax check; other occurrences are only reported. The PLC tag is not renamed. Run with dry_run=true first.

new_name.description: New HMI tag name. It must not exist yet (compared case-insensitively, system tags included) and must not contain . [ ] { } " ' ` \ or :.

table_name.description: Optional exact tag-table name (or 'group/table' path) that must contain the tag. Tag names are unique per HMI software, so this is only a safety check.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

on_conflict.description: Required conflict behavior; only 'fail' is supported.

script_references.description: 'report' (default) only lists script occurrences of the old name; 'replace' also rewrites string literals that are exactly the old name and verifies each script by read-back and by a syntax check that must not report more errors than before.

dry_run.description: Only report what the rename would touch; change nothing (default: false).
